stock.description: As an investment holding company, OKG Technology Holdings Limited delivers foundation construction and associated services across Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. Its operations are structured into several segments: Foundation, Building Construction Works and Ancillary Services, Construction Wastes Handling Services, Digital Assets Related Businesses, Technical Services, and Other Business. The company's offerings include site preparation, excavation with lateral support, various piling techniques, construction of pile caps and footings, and reinforced concrete structures. Additionally, it undertakes general building construction, provides auxiliary services like hoarding and demolition, and offers machinery for lease. Furthermore, OKG Technology manages and operates facilities designed for receiving public fill, encompassing public fill banks and temporary sorting centers for construction and demolition waste materials. Beyond these, it engages in securities investment and money lending activities. Its technology portfolio extends to the development and management of the USDK smart contract. The firm also provides technology development, IT infrastructure solutions, project management, digital asset trading, trust and custody services, alongside internet content and value-added telecommunications services. Established in 2001 and headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, the company adopted its current name, OKG Technology Holdings Limited, in February 2020, having previously been known as LEAP Holdings Group Limited. It operates as a subsidiary of OKC Holdings Corporation.
